implemented.validation: strict, no private roots/project IDs/credential strings/reset fields
implemented.ledgerReview: pure supplied-byte validation and accounting; no file writes or implicit creation/migration
implemented.compaction: inherit-native intent only; original engine/config unchanged

plannedHostBindings.projects: registered recovery authorities, retain memoryKey and scope
plannedHostBindings.budget: governed canonical ledger path, preserve observed entries/reservations/revisions
plannedHostBindings.externalRuntimes: explicit provider/launcher configuration; no automatic start

preservation: budget entries, unknown reservations, reconciliations, initialSpent and per-session overrides
missingOrCorruptLedger: block existing-budget review; never silently initialize a fresh balance
policyChanges: supplied defaults are intent only; existing persisted policy wins. Session changes must use revision-checked human settings. Shared/round policy requires explicit host handling.
legacyLedger: review original version only; controlled migration belongs to subsequent host integration
